title: Boy Steve Riding Neighbor's Bike in Driveway, 1958 Suburban Snapshot Photo
description: A deckle-edged black-and-white snapshot dated November 1958 showing a young boy named Steve happily riding a neighbor's small two-wheeled bicycle down a concrete suburban driveway. Behind him sits a neat lawn, single-story ranch-style homes, and towering electrical transmission pylons, showcasing typical mid-century American suburban development and everyday childhood leisure.
